scope: All seven direct META27.0 Catechol-Degradation members plus shared modules, meta umbrella and protocatechuate sibling. This is not a global pathway-universe inventory.

alternatives.label: catechol degradation II (meta-cleavage pathway)
alternatives.disposition: Actively researched next262: distinct complete seven-step oxidative meta route; not reselected.

alternatives.label: catechol degradation I (meta-cleavage pathway)
alternatives.disposition: Maintained complete five-step hydrolytic meta route in258 baseline; duplicate rejected.

alternatives.label: aromatic compounds degradation via β-ketoadipate
alternatives.disposition: Combines catechol and protocatechuate branches plus tail; broader multi-entry umbrella rejected for this single-route addition.

alternatives.label: catechol degradation III (ortho-cleavage pathway)
alternatives.disposition: Select complete six-step ortho route with explicit parent intermodule join. No individual maintained record covers its complete defined boundary; all six chemistries are already present across two different module records.

alternatives.label: catechol degradation to β-ketoadipate
alternatives.disposition: Maintained upstream four-step child; duplicate and narrower than selected full route.

alternatives.label: catechol degradation to 2-hydroxypentadienoate II
alternatives.disposition: Four-step oxidative child of planned262; cannot count as an extra complete pathway.

alternatives.label: catechol degradation to 2-hydroxypentadienoate I
alternatives.disposition: Two-step hydrolytic child of maintained261; cannot count as an extra complete pathway.

alternatives.label: 2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate degradation
alternatives.disposition: Shared three-step meta terminal module; part of261/262, not a new full-catechol route.

alternatives.label: 3-oxoadipate degradation
alternatives.disposition: Maintained two-step tail; include within selected full route, not a second new module record.

alternatives.label: meta cleavage pathway of aromatic compounds
alternatives.disposition: Broader benzoate/meta alternative umbrella; no single exact catechol-route identity.

alternatives.label: protocatechuate degradation II (ortho-cleavage pathway)
alternatives.disposition: Already maintained as exact GO0019618 four-step sibling; different substrate and upstream chemistry, no new record for this native synonym.
